name: Quebec Skilled Worker Selection Program (PSTQ)
name_fr: Programme de sélection des travailleurs qualifiés (PSTQ)
description: Quebec selects its own economic immigrants under the Canada–Québec Accord. Candidates declare interest in Arrima and are invited by criteria that often include French at a set level; Quebec-selected people then apply to IRCC for permanent residence outside Express Entry.

streams.1_highly_qualified: Oral French level 7+ and written level 5+ (Quebec scale)
streams.2_intermediate_and_manual: Spoken French level 5+; accompanying spouse spoken level 4+
streams.3_regulated_professions: Depends on FEER level: 0–2 as Stream 1; 3–5 spoken level 5

attributes.process: Declaration of interest in Arrima; invitations by round with published criteria (2026 rounds through 24 September 2026 listed); 30 days to accept an invitation; French must be proven with an accepted test even for native speakers.
attributes.volume: Quebec government announced monthly invitations toward about 29,000 economic immigrants (2026 plan).
attributes.politics: A Parti Québécois minority government was elected on 5 October 2026 (news reports); its immigration plan for 2027 may change targets.
attributes.status_dependency: French ability and occupation decide eligibility; both unknown (USER-PROFILE.md). Quebec is in scope only if a bilingual environment is acceptable (USER-PROFILE.md flexible preferences).
